['Aunde Group '].company_description: The Aunde Group operates in the management and consultancy services, research & development, and energy management industries. Its products and services include surface technologies, seat systems, technical springs, interior modules, and technical plastic parts.

['Diehl Stiftung & Co. KG '].company_description: Diehl Stiftung & Co. KG operates in the defense and industrial sectors. Its divisions include Diehl Defence, which specializes in the production of missiles and ammunition, and Diehl Metall, which produces semi-finished products, forgings, and high-precision stamped parts with plating technologies.
